golden_rules.query: Voltage input check for 12V models
golden_rules.test_method: Measure input voltage at terminals with voltmeter
golden_rules.failure_indication: Outside voltage range may damage unit or cause malfunction

golden_rules.query: Voltage input check for 24V models
golden_rules.expected_value: 21V - 31V DC
golden_rules.test_method: Measure input voltage at terminals with voltmeter
golden_rules.failure_indication: Outside voltage range may damage unit or cause malfunction

golden_rules.query: Maximum continuous operation time
golden_rules.expected_value: 4 minutes
golden_rules.test_method: Time operation duration with stopwatch
golden_rules.failure_indication: Exceeding time limit risks motor overheating

golden_rules.query: Minimum chain gypsy engagement
golden_rules.expected_value: 3 chain links minimum
golden_rules.test_method: Visual inspection of chain engagement
golden_rules.failure_indication: Less engagement may cause slipping or chain jump

golden_rules.query: Waterproof rating verification
golden_rules.expected_value: IP66 protection level
golden_rules.test_method: Verify seal integrity and housing condition
golden_rules.failure_indication: Compromised sealing may lead to water ingress

golden_rules.query: What is the maximum working load for 1500W 24V model?
golden_rules.test_method: Load cell measurement under controlled conditions
golden_rules.failure_indication: Windlass unable to safely handle specified load

golden_rules.query: What is the current draw at working load for 1000W 12V?
golden_rules.test_method: Ammeter measurement during normal operation
golden_rules.failure_indication: Excessive current draw indicates mechanical problem or motor fault

golden_rules.query: What is the required circuit breaker rating for 700W 24V?
golden_rules.test_method: Verify circuit breaker rating matches specification
golden_rules.failure_indication: Incorrect breaker may cause nuisance trips or fail to protect

golden_rules.query: What is the acceptable deck thickness range?
golden_rules.test_method: Physical measurement of deck thickness
golden_rules.failure_indication: Installation not possible if outside range

golden_rules.query: What is the minimum motor cable size for 1500W 12V?
golden_rules.expected_value: 50 mm² (AWG0)
golden_rules.test_method: Physical verification of installed cable gauge
golden_rules.failure_indication: Undersized cable causes voltage drop and overheating

golden_rules.query: What is maximum chain speed for 1000W 24V?
golden_rules.expected_value: 40.9 m/min
golden_rules.test_method: Timed chain retrieval test under no load
golden_rules.failure_indication: Speed below spec indicates mechanical or electrical issues

golden_rules.query: Is windlass properly aligned with bow roller?
golden_rules.expected_value: Gypsy must be in perfect alignment with bow roller
golden_rules.test_method: Visual inspection and measurement of alignment
golden_rules.failure_indication: Loss of motor power and improper chain operation

golden_rules.query: Are deck surfaces parallel where windlass mounts?
golden_rules.expected_value: Upper and lower deck surfaces must be parallel
golden_rules.test_method: Measure deck thickness at all mounting points
golden_rules.failure_indication: Loss of motor power due to misalignment

golden_rules.query: Is chain path clear below deck?
golden_rules.expected_value: No obstacles in cable, rope and chain path
golden_rules.test_method: Visual inspection of chain locker and path
golden_rules.failure_indication: Chain jamming during operation

golden_rules.query: Are mounting stud bolts properly secured?
golden_rules.expected_value: Stud bolts installed with medium grade locking compound
golden_rules.test_method: Visual inspection of thread compound application
golden_rules.failure_indication: Loose mounting hardware, unstable operation

golden_rules.query: Is base edge properly sealed?
golden_rules.expected_value: Silicone sealant applied around entire base edge
golden_rules.test_method: Visual inspection of sealant application
golden_rules.failure_indication: Water intrusion below deck

golden_rules.query: Is power isolated during navigation?
golden_rules.expected_value: Circuit breaker switched off and chain secured
golden_rules.test_method: Verify circuit breaker position and chain securing
golden_rules.failure_indication: Risk of accidental activation during navigation

golden_rules.query: Is circuit breaker properly rated for voltage?
golden_rules.expected_value: 4A for 12V systems, 2A for 24V systems
golden_rules.test_method: Check circuit breaker rating against system voltage
golden_rules.failure_indication: Incorrect breaker rating could cause nuisance trips or inadequate protection

golden_rules.query: Are chain counter sensor cables correctly color-coded?
golden_rules.expected_value: White, Green, and Black wires present and properly connected
golden_rules.test_method: Visual inspection of chain counter sensor cable connections
golden_rules.failure_indication: Counter may not function or give incorrect readings

golden_rules.query: Is total cable length within specification?
golden_rules.expected_value: L = L1 + L2 + L3 must not exceed maximum specified length
golden_rules.test_method: Measure and sum individual cable segments
golden_rules.failure_indication: Voltage drop may affect performance if too long

golden_rules.query: Are watertight remote connections sealed?

golden_rules.test_method: Visual inspection of seals and connection points
